name: False Idols

perks.name: Hungry Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Blade
perks.desc: Greatly increased sword ammo at the cost of damage.

perks.name: Honed Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.desc: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Tempered Edge
perks.desc: Increased sword damage and ammo.

perks.name: Balanced Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.

perks.name: Burst Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.

perks.name: Enduring Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

perks.name: Swordmaster's Guard
perks.desc: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.desc: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.desc: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Flash Counter
perks.desc: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.

perks.name: Eager Edge
perks.desc: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.desc: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Incandescent and Chain Reaction, need I say more? Oh, I do? Okay. Bait and Switch or Vorpal gives you some respectable damage. Relentless Strikes giving you slightly better ammo economy on beefier targets, and to clear rooms with ease I'd use Unrelenting for health back on kills." Recommended MW: Impact.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "In the crucible you don't have a lot of great options. Unrelenting giving you health on double kills. Double kills being slightly easier with Chain Reaction. Aside from memes in 6v6 I don't see this weapon being used." Recommended MW: Impact.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 106 from 18 June 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0GYlriUxhFqNHGLqb84C1G?si=bb5a2c9b339d4c35) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for sustained Boss damage in end-game content. Shapeable. False Idols is the latest vortex frame sword, and as all swords have pretty much the same stats, this is definitely in-band. Like all vortex frames, it's not currently good for boss damage with the cost/benefit of the spin-to-win heavy attack but if you want to save one for a possible future buff, start with a blade perk that boosts damage. In the guard perk slot, Swordmaster's Guard just buffs a little bit of everything. Then, in the first trait perk slot, Relentless Strikes passively returns ammo on hits while, in the second, Bait and Switch adds +30% damage when procced, or in the right circumstances, Surrounded adds +35% damage (+41.75% when enhanced). The Dealer's Choice origin trait is nice to have (who doesn't love more super energy?) - with two or three Pale Heart weapons, you'll notice the difference! Recommended MW: Impact, with a Backup Mag mod.
